title: After the Kikuka Sho: Buried Beneath Chrysanthemums

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's a Mejiro! A Mejiro seizes the third and final chrysanthemum crown! It's Mejiro Ryan with a flawless win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I… I won!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Against McQueen and Ines, at the Kikuka Sho… At this race I dreamed of winning!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ryaaan! That was amaaazing! You ran so well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Thank you! You can count on me to keep pressing on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the winner's circle is engulfed in cheers for the victor…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I carry Ines Fujin to the waiting room. She undergoes a brief examination, but the doctor tells me she's perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Where… am I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh. I collapsed again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …This is pathetic. I've caused so much trouble and made everyone worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I was supposed to pull it together. And my sisters were watching too… This means I—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: W-well, um… It's just, you know…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: There was that whole mess before the race, and then I went and passed out, so I… I'm just really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm okay, though. I am. I won't mess up ever again! No matter what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin may insist that she's fine now, but she certainly doesn't look it.
choice_data_list: I want you to tell me if something happened.
I want you to tell me if something happened.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. Nothing happened at all. I'm fine. Totally fine…
choice_data_list: What matters to you matters to me, too.
What matters to you matters to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …! B-but… it's like…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can't take care of the things that are important to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes well up like a dam about to burst.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Last time I visited home… I found out something that shocked me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My sisters quit their dance lessons so they could help out around the house.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Our mom gets sick a lot. And she's been going through another bad spell lately, so she's in and out of hospital.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My sisters said they're going to take care of her in my place, since I can't be there right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is all because I left home to satisfy my own selfish desire to race…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why did you two give up dancing?! I can just quit racing and come home. That will solve everything!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: You're wrong! You don't get it, Big Sis! Just go back to the academy already!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: I won't forgive you if you quit racing to stay at home! I'll never talk to you again!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: This is something me and Polly set our minds on! If you go and quit racing now, then…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text: Sigh. We all discussed this, and we want you to pursue your dream. So there's no need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So… you two will be happy as long as I don't give up on running?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But you don't need to handle everything yourselves. There are plenty of housekeeping services these days, and I could pay for it with my wages.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So please don't let go of your dreams… Promise me that one thing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I worked all I could to send more money home, but that just made them more worried that I'd end up ruining my health.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wanted to put their minds at ease, to show them I wasn't overdoing it. I even changed my running style in an attempt to blow away all their worries.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's why I didn't want them to see me collapse after the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If things keep going like this, then…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry! I guess it's not really that big a deal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It is what it is, you know? Besides, I'm sure girls born into prestigious families are under a lot more pressure than I am.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It kind of feels like I should be doing all this bellyaching about race-related stuff, huh? Like a major injury or something.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for burdening you with something so trivial. It's a family matter, so there's no need for you to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: It's an important issue for you, right?
It's an important issue for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: I won't let you shoulder this alone.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Waaaaah! Sob, sob…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tears that had been filling Ines Fujin's eyes finally begin to overflow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her shoulders tremble as she sobs. I gently put my arm around her in an offer of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once she eventually calms down, we talk about what her next step should be.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The next step, huh?
choice_data_list: How about taking a bit of a break?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, that might be a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'd like that. A short one. Just until I figure out how to handle my situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: As for my next major goal… Would it be all right to choose something far off? Say, early spring?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai is a G1 race held in spring. At 2,000 meters on turf, the distance shouldn't pose an issue. It's even held at Hanshin Racecourse, just like the Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That sounds good. I think I can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Kikuka Sho, I make a phone call that I believe will be important in supporting Ines Fujin going forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brrring, brrring…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hello, is this Ines's trainer? Thank you for always looking out for my daughter.
choice_data_list: It's been nothing but a pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry we haven't had many opportunities to speak on the phone like this. Are you calling about the matter we discussed previously?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Actually, I have a request of my own. I hesitate to ask considering the situation, but regarding the Arima Kinen…
